name: Slitherlink: Logic Loop Puzzle
tagline: Connect the dots to form a single continuous loop. Pure, relaxing logic puzzle.
blurb: Challenge your brain with Slitherlink, the timeless Japanese logic puzzle where deductive reasoning meets minimalist design.
description: Challenge your brain with Slitherlink, the timeless Japanese logic puzzle where deductive reasoning meets minimalist design. Also known as Fences, Loop the Loop, Takegaki, or Suriza, this clean, grid-based puzzle offers endless hours of relaxing yet deeply satisfying mental exercise.
